name: get_system_stats
description: Get an overall system stats snapshot including CPU, RAM, Disk, and Battery usage.

name: get_cpu_usage
description: Get the current CPU usage percentage across all cores.

name: get_memory_usage
description: Get current system RAM memory usage, total memory, and free memory.

name: get_disk_usage
description: Get primary disk drive space usage and available free storage.

name: get_battery_status
description: Get the laptop battery status, percentage, and charging power connection.

name: get_volume
description: Get current system volume level (0 to 100) and mute status.

name: set_volume
description: Set system volume to a specified percentage level from 0 to 100.

name: media_play
description: Resume or start system media playback.

name: media_next
description: Skip to the next song or video track.

name: media_previous
description: Return to the previous song or video track.

name: launch_app
description: Launch an installed desktop application by name (e.g., Chrome, Notepad, VS Code, Calculator).

name.description: Name or alias of the application to open (e.g. 'chrome', 'notepad', 'code')

name: close_app
description: Close or terminate running instances of an application by name.

name.description: Name of the application process to close (e.g. 'chrome', 'spotify', 'notepad')

name: get_running_apps
description: Get a list of currently active running desktop applications.

name: search_files
description: Search for files or folders matching a query keyword in a directory.

query.description: File name or keyword search query

directory.description: Directory path to search in (defaults to User Home directory)
